description: This Dart source file defines a class 'MockNewsData' that provides mock news articles for use as fallback data when the network is unavailable. It contains a method 'forCategory' that returns a list of sample 'NewsArticle' instances, including category-specific and general mock articles.

classes.name: MockNewsData
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate mock news articles for testing or offline use.

methods.name: forCategory
methods.description: A static method that returns a list of mock 'NewsArticle' objects, tailored to a given category, including general and category-specific sample articles.
